description: 116-year longitudinal temperature heatmap for Greater Melbourne.
methodology: Data was extracted from ACORN-SAT v2.3 daily maximum temperature records (Station 086338 - Olympic Park). Daily observations were aggregated into monthly means using a temporal grouping algorithm in Pandas to reduce high-frequency noise while preserving the 'Heat Wall' signal of the last decade. Data spans January 1910 to early 2026.
citation: Bureau of Meteorology. (2026). Australian Climate Observations Reference Network - Surface Air Temperature (ACORN-SAT). Australian Government.
